relationship between the revenue generated by the inﬂation tax and the inﬂation rate.

of revenue that must be raised. But the inﬂation rate a¤ects the base against whichthe tax is levied. For a given base, a higher inﬂation rate raises seigniorage, but a
higher inﬂation rate raises the opportunity cost of holding money and reduces the de-
mand for money, thereby lowering the base against which the tax is levied. This
